Two pre-existing issues are deferred as out of this ticket's explicitly scoped fix — the sibling request field has the same undefined-drops-from-JSON exposure, and deleteFeedback's un-awaited call means its catch block never runs on failure; nothing was dismissed.

findings.title: Empty-string response backend acceptance unconfirmed
findings.problem: The new `message.response ?? ''` fallback (lines 96 and 142) always sends a string, but neither the diff nor the task's own technical analysis confirms whether the backend's FeedbackRequest.response validator accepts an empty string — only that it must be a non-null string. If it has a min-length/non-empty constraint, disliking or liking a message with no response text will still 422, just with a different validation message.
findings.impact: The exact regression this ticket exists to fix (422 on feedback submission when response has no text) could resurface for every message with a legitimately empty response, and the new generic error toast would mask it as an unexplained failure rather than surfacing the real cause.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with the backend team (or by testing against a live backend) that POST /v1/feedback accepts response: "" before relying on this fallback; if it does not, coordinate a schema/validation adjustment or send a non-empty placeholder string instead.
